h1: What TypePHP Means for the Future of PHP Performance
social: TypePHP by Swoole: How It Works, Laravel Support, Benchmarks and Limits
short: TypePHP Explained: Swoole's PHP AOT Compiler and What It Means for Laravel
desc: TypePHP is Swoole's open-source AOT compiler: PHP to C++ to native code. Laravel support, README benchmarks (6.5–8×), GitHub, limits and when to use it.
keywords: typephp, swoole typephp, typephp laravel, typephp github, php aot compiler, php to c++, swoole aot
faq: Not as a whole. TypePHP compiles a typed subset of PHP and makes no Laravel support claims. Keep Laravel on regular PHP, with Octane for performance, and compile only isolated, strictly typed hot paths.
Yes. The Swoole team published it on GitHub at swoole/typephp under the GPL-3.0 licence.

The README reports about 8x on bench.php and 6.5x on micro_bench.php compared with interpreted PHP. These are the project's own CPU-bound benchmarks; typical database-bound web requests gain far less.
Not for general use as of November 2026. The project describes itself as under active development and supports a defined subset of PHP.
